'''Blue Squadron''' was a [[Nharwaak]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron that used [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]]. They fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Battle of Mylok IV|Conflict at Mylok IV]].
